newsitem.title: USA: Alabama sees lowest jobless rate in 25 years.
newsitem.headline: Alabama sees lowest jobless rate in 25 years.

text.p: Alabama's unemployment rate plunged to 4 percent in December, the lowest rate since the state began its tracking system in 1972, state officials said.
December's rate was down from 5 percent in November and 5.3 percent a year ago.
Most of the job growth was in lumber and wood products, textiles, retail trade and government, said Dottie Cieszynski, director of State Industrial Relations.
She said most of the gains were in urban areas, while several rural areas lagged.
Shelby County had the state's lowest unemployment rate for December, 1.4 percent, while Bullock County had the highest, 22.7 perent.
